description: Ten-row create import whose guardians carry no e-mail, after the same two warmups as student_batch.import. Measured by TestStudentImportWithoutGuardianEmailQueryBudget. The chunk executor writes the new guardians of a segment (profiles, phones, relationships with the retention reset, pickup permissions, portal accesses) with one statement per table under the second bound instead of eight statements per row (#5552 step 5c, PR #6514); 193 on development before. Step 7 creates the student profiles of a segment in one statement before the rows and their care profiles in one statement after them; memberships stay per row (#5552, PR #6558).
